facts.F19: One catalogue row per Models type: KernelCatalogue (test side, Tests/Architecture) holds one row per top-level Models type, standing Kernel or Owned(owner context or Platform lane, blockers, freeing Story). Blockers are a closed set, each a property measured from the IL or the EF model, never a name: Entity (in LighthouseAppContext's model), Wire (reachable from a controller action signature or an API.DTO public property, transitively), HeldBy(type) (a staying Models type references it), Shared (IL users in two or more Modules.<X> contexts), InfraReached (named by Data, a repository or the composition root), PathPinned(consumer) (a non-test consumer reads its file by path), Event (implements IDomainEvent). A row with no blocker is a mover and is allowed only while it is on the shrink-only movers list.
